talking_points: This is for the founder who feels chained to their desk.
I need you to hear this. You can and you will build a business that serves your life, not the other way around. You have everything you need right now to make that happen.
Honestly, it's hard to even post this. There are days I feel like a fraud, talking about living offline while I'm stuck tweaking a system late at night.
Those moments are tough, and they feel like a compromise. I know how much it feels like you're sacrificing the life you wanted for the business you're building.
And I know so many of you are in the same spot, because I get your messages every single day.
The internet will always tell you to do more, to grind harder, to never switch off. It will sell you a version of success that costs you your time.
But you have to keep your eyes on what actually matters. The business is a tool, not the prize. Your life is the prize.
Nobody will remember the emails you answered after 5 PM or the funnels you optimized on a Saturday. They will remember that you were present.
This video is me showing up for that idea. I could be working right now, but I'm outside, choosing to prove this is possible.
I want to be living proof that you can build the right engines in your business so you can choose your life, again and again. If you want to build those engines, check out FieldWork.
